source_index.note: Hackage SHA256 target metadata supplied archive hashes; recorded HTTPS provenance, not a claim of independently verified TUF signatures.

coverage.supplemental_policy: All published versions before the release cutoff of potential function-only/compatibility/build-tool packages and supporting package families are supplied. These are a conservative source superset, not claims that all versions are linked. Binary-derived package versions are pinned separately.

native_components.libyaml: C source supplied in libyaml-clib historical source variants
native_components.GMP: 6.3.0 with GHC patches; inferred from official GHC9.10.3 aarch64-Darwin in-tree-GMP build recipe
native_components.other: isocline, crypton and other package C sources remain in original Hackage archives. libSystem, zlib, libiconv, libcharset, libffi and Security are dynamically supplied by macOS.

limitations: Upstream publishes its release build script but no exact arm64 Cabal plan/index-state. Function-only package versions and selected .cabal revisions are not recoverable from the stripped executable; their possible source variants are included.

The reconstruction recipe preserves known package versions and upstream feature flags, but an identical executable hash is not promised. Compiler/linker, optimization, macOS SDK and signing differences can change bytes.
